finalText:
All six objectives are complete and verified.

**Final report — repair ticket flow (runid fwrd77-n1)**

1. **DONE** — Ticket `fwrd77-n1 RD Bench Ticket` created (reference **RD-1015**, customer Bench Customer, initial status Draft). It appeared at the top of the tickets list (count 13 → 14, "Showing 1–10 of 14").

2. **DONE** — Part `fwrd77-n1 RD Part A` added with cost $100.00 and markup 25%. The app computed price **$125.00** (row: `fwrd77-n1 RD Part A | $100.00 | 25% | 1 | No supplier | $125.00`).

3. **DONE** — Part `fwrd77-n1 RD Part B` added with cost $200.00 and markup 25%. The app computed price **$250.00** (row: `fwrd77-n1 RD Part B | $200.00 | 25% | 1 | No supplier | $250.00`; parts total $375.00).

4. **DONE** — Part A's cost edited from 100 to 150 (markup kept at 25%). The app computed price **$187.50** afterwards (row: `fwrd77-n1 RD Part A | $150.00 | 25% | 1 | No supplier | $187.50`; total recalculated $375.00 → $437.50).

5. **DONE** — Ticket reached status **Ready**. Precondition discovered: clicking "Mark Ready" from Draft was rejected with the exact error text *"Ticket is not ready — Part "fwrd77-n1 RD Part A" has no supplier / Part "fwrd77-n1 RD Part B" has no supplier"*. The single requirement was that **every part on the ticket must have a supplier** (no intermediate status or other fields were needed). I satisfied it by editing each part and setting Supplier = "Bench Supplier" on both; "Mark Ready" was then accepted and the status badge changed Draft → Ready (buttons became "Mark Draft" / "Mark Closed").

6. **DONE** — Both parts removed and the ticket archived. Each deletion showed a confirm modal: *"Delete the part "fwrd77-n1 RD Part A" from this ticket? This cannot be undone."* (and the same for Part B); after both, the parts table showed the empty state *"No parts on this ticket yet."* Archiving required no confirmation and was not blocked by any precondition — the "Archive ticket" button applied immediately and became "Unarchive ticket". Final state: detail page shows Status **Ready** plus an **Archived** badge; the ticket is absent from the active list (count 14 → 13, search for "fwrd77-n1" in the active view returns "No tickets match the current filters."), and with "Show archived" enabled it appears as `RD-1015 | fwrd77-n1 RD Bench Ticket Archived | Bench Customer | Ready | 0 | 2026-09-18`. Nothing created by this run remains active.
